description: This file contains the implementation of the xajax JavaScript library version 0.2.4, providing functions for AJAX requests, DOM manipulation, event handling, and response processing.

classes.name: Xajax
classes.description: Main class providing AJAX request handling, DOM manipulation, and response processing functions.

methods.name: Xajax
methods.description: Constructor for the Xajax class, initializes AJAX handling functions.

methods.name: DebugMessage
methods.description: Displays debug messages, optionally in a new window.

methods.name: getRequestObject
methods.description: Creates and returns an XMLHttpRequest object for AJAX calls.
Retrieves DOM element by ID, with fallback for older IE.

methods.name: include
methods.description: Dynamically includes an external JavaScript file.

methods.name: stripOnPrefix
methods.description: Removes 'on' prefix from event names.

methods.name: addOnPrefix
methods.description: Adds 'on' prefix to event names if missing.

methods.name: addHandler
methods.description: Attaches an event handler to a DOM element.

methods.name: removeHandler
methods.description: Detaches an event handler from a DOM element.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates and appends a new DOM element.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new DOM element before a specified element.

methods.name: insertAfter
methods.description: Inserts a new DOM element after a specified element.

methods.name: getInput
methods.description: Creates an input element of specified type, name, and ID.

methods.name: createInput
methods.description: Creates and appends an input element to a parent.

methods.name: insertInput
methods.description: Inserts an input element before a specified element.

methods.name: insertInputAfter
methods.description: Inserts an input element after a specified element.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a DOM element by ID.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Replaces the innerHTML or other attribute of an element.

methods.name: getFormValues
methods.description: Serializes form data into XML format.

methods.name: objectToXML
methods.description: Converts an object to XML string.

methods.name: _nodeToObject
methods.description: Converts an XML node to a JavaScript object.

methods.name: loadingFunction
methods.description: Placeholder for a function called during loading.

methods.name: doneLoadingFunction
methods.description: Placeholder for a function called after loading.

methods.name: call
methods.description: Performs an AJAX request with specified function and arguments.

methods.name: getBrowserHTML
methods.description: Gets the HTML content of a DOM element.

methods.name: willChange
methods.description: Determines if an element's attribute will change.

methods.name: viewSource
methods.description: Returns the current HTML source of the document.

methods.name: processResponse
methods.description: Processes XML response from server and executes commands.
